messages.subject: installation problem
parts:
Hi there, 
When I try to install methylkit (R version 4.0.1) i got this error massage:

make: gfortran: No such file or directory
make: *** [mvt.o] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘mvtnorm’
* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.0/Resources/library/mvtnorm’
Error: Failed to install 'methylKit' from GitHub:
  (converted from warning) installation of package ‘mvtnorm’ had non-zero exit status

and when i try :
> library(methylKit)

i got this 

Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘methylKit’ in loadNamespace(j <- i[[1L]], c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[j]]):
 there is no package called ‘mvtnorm’

I tried to install "mvtnorm" but i got :

Warning in install.packages :
  installation of package ‘mvtnorm’ had non-zero exit status


Thank you
